strict_alignment_result.interpretation: Synthetic agent numbers are local row identifiers inside a population snapshot. Reusing the same number across March and June does not establish the same simulated individual.

transferable_behavior_mechanism_result.interpretation: The cross-time unit is the reviewed behavior variant, not the numbered agent. The same frozen behavioral mechanism can be checked for selective adaptation to different shocks.

within_snapshot_policy_alignment.valid_same_agent_comparison: Within this artifact only, the same synthetic agent can be compared across baseline and combined policy branches after the shared baseline.

evaluation_design.within_snapshot_unit: same synthetic_agent_id across phases or policy branches
evaluation_design.cross_snapshot_unit: same persona_variant_id with frozen profile fields
evaluation_design.reason: A behavior type that stays silent under an irrelevant shock can be more faithful than one that reacts to every event.
forbidden_claims: same numbered agent is the same individual across March and June
policy-branch differences are observational causal effects
synthetic agents are digital twins of real students
